quest.title: Tending to a Tepetlisaurus: In Need of a Trim
quest.description: Cazcal seems to be trying out a whole new way of looking after Hora...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Don't go running off again this time, alright, Hora?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: R—Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hora's been such a good boy today!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hasn't he just? All thanks to that Driftyball you helped me make!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: I'll be able to get Hora to do all sorts of things with this ball, whether it's washing, eating, sleeping, or training... Everything'll be so much easier from here on in.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Not to mention trimming his claws! Before, even just chasing him down was enough to exhaust me...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Now, all I have to do is show him this ball, and he'll sit down like he's been house-trained.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Rrroo, rroo...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: #Hora, do you remember who this is? {M#He's}{F#She's} the one who helped make your toy!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Orrooo, orrooo!

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Oh wow, Hora definitely remembers you! And he's happy to see you, too!

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Do you want to try trimming his claws? You can wipe his horn down while you're at it.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: This is very important for little Tepetlisaurs. After all, they have to be able to dig through rocks and earth, so their claws need to be kept nice and sharp, with any broken or wonky ones trimmed back into shape.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: It's the only way to guarantee that they'll have a pair of perfect claws when they turn into adults...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Here, take this! If we're doing some trimming anyway, we might as well take this chance to give Hora a full-body makeover!

choices.text: That's quite a lot of detail...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: *cough* Well, Hora's rarely this well-behaved. It just occurred to me that I won't need to chase him around the entire tribe today, so I couldn't help feeling happy...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: It's nothing! Anyway, we'd better get started. I'll be right by your side telling you what to do.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: To help Hora relax, you'll need to gently clean his back with the big brush...

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Then switch to a finer brush to clean his horn. Put your back into that one, or you'll miss some of the dirt clogging them cracks.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: After that, you'll need to use a towel to wipe his entire body down... That way, he'll gradually start to relax and extend his claws, and then you'll be able to give them a trim.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: That goes without saying! I raised Hora myself, after all. There's no one else in the entire tribe... actually, make that the whole of Natlan, who knows him better than I do.

response.speaker: Cazcal
response.text: Alright, just follow the instructions I just gave and help give Hora's claws a trim. I'll be right next to you, so just ask if there's anything you're unclear about.

choices.text: You really know him well, huh...
Why the sudden wave of excitement?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora gradually relaxes. He stretches out his whole body and extends his claws. Looks like it's time to give them a trim.)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Under Cazcal's guidance, you carefully trim Hora's claws.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I never expected you'd be so good at this!

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Roarrr, roarrr, roar—

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora's thanking you too. You did such a careful job, I've no doubt he'll be drilling away even faster than before.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Here, take these as a token of my appreciation. Oh yes, and I should probably warn you... If you ever have to look after any other little Saurians in future, whatever you do, don't just copy the method I taught you today.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Each little Saurian has its own unique temperament, so you have to look after them in different ways. Even after all this time, I've still only figured out how to take care of Hora.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Still, I'm just glad that I've even gotten that far. After all, the two of us will have to put up with one another for a long while yet...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's Hora? Don't tell me he's run off again...!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora! Horaaaaaaaa—

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora tilts his head, scratches his belly, before looking at you in confusion.)

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: You can't be playing with Hora the whole time, y'know? Gotta move onto the real business sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: *cough* Allow me, alright? I'll demonstrate the proper way to go about this.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Cazcal takes over before things deteriorate any further. After another stint of careful grooming, he finally manages to finish trimming Hora's claws...)

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Now then, don't focus solely on playing with Hora. You've got a job to do, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Hroo! Wrrooo!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hahaha, looks like Hora does like you though. No wonder he was so obedient this time.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: In any case, thanks so much for your help. Please, take these for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hmm... Perhaps I should play with Hora as much as I can before starting the wash...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: So, what do you think, Hora?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's Hora? Don't tell me he's run off again...!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hora! Horaaaaaaaa—

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Raar? Rrooh? Hrroo...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Pet Hora's tummy...)

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Roar... Roar.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: To help Hora relax, you'll need to gently clean his back with the big brush...

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Then switch to a finer brush to clean his horn. Put your back into that one, or you'll miss some of the dirt clogging them cracks.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: After that, you'll need to use a towel to wipe his entire body down... That way, he'll gradually start to relax and extend his claws, and then you'll be able to give them a trim.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Squeeze Hora's paw...)

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Oroo, orooo...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I should be able to trim Hora's nails now...)

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Hora

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Hora

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora blinks, confused, before turning outward. Did I make him uncomfortable at some point...?)

dialogues.speaker: Hora

dialogues.text: (Hora blinks, confused, before turning outward. Did I make him uncomfortable at some point...?)

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: (Hora doesn't seem to find it relaxing at all, and just stares back at you in confusion.)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (Cazcal takes over before things deteriorate any further. After another stint of careful grooming, he finally manages to finish trimming Hora's claws...)

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: It's okay, I misread Hora sometimes too. The important thing is, I'm sure he knows that you're a good friend of his.

dialogues.speaker: Hora
dialogues.text: Wroo, rrooh!

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Hahaha! See, what did I tell you?

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for your help. Please, take these for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: Little Saurians really are hard nuts to crack. It took me a long time getting to know Hora before I could figure out most of what he was thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Cazcal
dialogues.text: I'm just glad I managed to get that far. After all, the two of us will have to put up with one another for a while yet...
